# Akaththí Farms

> Urban mushroom and microgreens farm based in Tamil Nadu, India. Science-backed, honestly grown fresh produce for homes and restaurants.

## About

Akaththí Farms is an urban specialty mushroom and microgreens farm operating in Polichalur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Founded to bring premium, sustainably grown fungi to local consumers and professional kitchens. The name "Akaththí" is Tamil, meaning inner/interior — reflecting the controlled indoor growing environment and the depth of care behind every harvest.

**Tagline:** Good Food. Good Science. Honestly Grown.

**Website:** https://www.akaththifarms.com

## Products

### Currently Available

- **Elm Oyster Mushrooms** (Hypsizygus ulmarius) — mild, firm, versatile. Sold fresh.
- **Pink Oyster Mushrooms** (Pleurotus djamor) — vibrant colour, slightly sweet, quick-cooking.
- **Golden Oyster Mushrooms** (Pleurotus citrinopileatus) — delicate, nutty, visually striking.

### Coming Soon

- King Oyster (Pleurotus eryngii)
- Pioppino (Cyclocybe aegerita)
- Shimeji (Hypsizygus tessellatus)

All varieties are grown in climate-controlled, substrate-optimised growing rooms. No pesticides. Harvested fresh and delivered within 24–48 hours.

## Farming

The farm uses controlled environment agriculture (CEA) principles:
- Substrate: lignocellulosic agricultural waste (e.g., paddy straw, sawdust, cotton hulls)
- Climate: temperature, humidity, CO₂, and airflow are monitored and automated
- No synthetic pesticides or herbicides
- Harvest-to-delivery within 24–48 hours

Read more: https://www.akaththifarms.com/farms.html

## Company

Akaththí Farms is an early-stage food tech startup incubated in Tamil Nadu. The team combines backgrounds in mycology, food science, engineering, and design.

Company page: https://www.akaththifarms.com/company.html
